verdict.rationale: Capacities documents first-party Chat Connectors that link external AI chat apps (ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, Le Chat) to a space. It also documents an official MCP integration so external agents and bots can reach notes, which directly covers the story's first-party connector path. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the connectors work, and detail on connector setup, scope, and read/write permissions (the connector docs are only a one-line claim).
